warnings: types.go already imports 'time' (line 9) — no need to add it

Close() calls m.wg.Wait() THEN m.cancel() — tests that call Close() will block until all turns finish, so the cooldown timer cancellation via ctx.Done() only works if Close() is changed to cancel-then-wait (that's the implementation subtask's problem, not this one)
The Cooldown constant must come AFTER Refused in the iota block to get value 4 — order matters
Tests are expected to FAIL because lifecycle.go does not implement cooldown logic yet — do not try to make them pass
The test for TestCooldown_CloseDoesNotHang needs a timeout mechanism (e.g., channel + select with time.After) to detect if Close() hangs beyond 1s, since the test itself must not hang forever

lifecycleMockRunner.ready channel is only closed on the FIRST Run() call — subsequent calls do not close it. For tests needing to detect when the second turn starts, a different synchronization approach is needed
TurnMetric.StartedAt and EndedAt are time.Time fields — for cooldown timing assertions, query with db.Order("started_at ASC") to get chronological order
